title: OKAY, Let's Go!
blurb: Ignition, compressed into about a second and a half. There is no information in this clip at all: no context, no subject, nothing beyond a person deciding that the thing is happening now. Strip away that much and it fits anything. It is the sound of a session starting, a plan going live, a lobby finally filling up. Play it before workouts, before road trips, before joining the ranked queue against your own better judgement. The enthusiasm is non-negotiable, entirely unearned and highly contagious. Let's go.
origin: A viral hype ignition clip from gaming culture.
